title: Custom PHP intranet migration: off Windows 2008 in a weekend
lede: An undocumented custom PHP intranet, a Windows 2008 box being pulled Monday, and one weekend. Here is the inventory, the breakages, and the cutover.
hero_alt: Ink-black brass plate engraved WIN2008 on a folded run-sheet over CUTOVER graph paper, manila tab, red wax seal, linen.
